tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background on screen. Cream in light, ink in dark.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised panels on bg: the contact band, notices, ghost-button hover.

tokens.name: paper-print
tokens.usage: White stock for printed documents (letterhead, proposals). Cream (`bg`) is an optional alternative stock.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, the wordmark, the seventh bar, primary button fill. On bg and paper in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (primary button, development banner).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Running text on bg, paper and paper-print.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and paper: ledes, descriptions, nav links, eyebrows, footers. 6.4:1 on cream, 7:1 on ink.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Dividers: step top borders (1.5px), dashed notice borders, footer rules. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: The faintest divider: edges of the paper contact band.

tokens.name: key-pink
tokens.usage: Bar 1 of the key strip. Method step Listen. Fills only, never text.

tokens.name: key-orange
tokens.usage: Bar 2 of the key strip. Fills only, never text.

tokens.name: key-yellow
tokens.usage: Bar 3 of the key strip. Method step Trace. Fills only; 1.9:1 on cream, so never a lone meaningful mark without a label.

tokens.name: key-green
tokens.usage: Bar 4 of the key strip. Method step Tune. Fills only, never text.

tokens.name: key-blue
tokens.usage: Bar 5 of the key strip. Method step Echo. Also the focus ring (3.1:1 on cream, 4.5:1 on ink).

tokens.name: key-purple
tokens.usage: Bar 6 of the key strip. Fills only, never text.

tokens.name: key-ink
tokens.usage: Bar 7 of the key strip: always the ink of the current theme, so it turns cream on dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 3px, on every link and button.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The live wordmark on the web hero only: "Tuned" roman, "Echo" italic, key strip below. Scales down to 54px on phones.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section headings (h2). One short sentence, ending with a period.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Tell us about the system you wish you had.
styles.usage: A single closing statement, such as the contact call. Max 22 characters per line.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Bold lead-ins of principles, set in serif roman (not bold).

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: Tuning your systems to echo your mission
styles.usage: The tagline under the hero wordmark, text color.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We take on software projects. A working prototype of your own workflow in weeks.
styles.usage: Running text on screen; max width `measure`.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Descriptions inside steps and principles, in muted.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Navigation links, muted; ink on hover.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows and notice labels. Always uppercase, muted (ink for notice labels).

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: Full-width status banner, uppercase, on-ink over ink.

styles.name: print-body
styles.usage: Letters, proposals and SOWs (about 11pt). Word files without the font fall back to Calibri.

styles.name: print-small
styles.sample: Tuned Echo Systems LLC · Brooklyn, NY
styles.usage: Letterhead contact block, running heads and footers (9pt). Never smaller.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between key-strip bars; gap between principle marker and text (12px at large sizes).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Title to description inside steps and cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to heading; gap between buttons; paragraph to paragraph.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Step top rule to its title.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Heading to intro; notice padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid gap between steps.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between principles and cards; page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between two-column service cards.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a full section on desktop (48px on phones).

tokens.name: print-margin
tokens.usage: 0.75in margin on printed pages.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels, notices, the contact band and print blocks: square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Key-strip bars, principle markers and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Method-step dots.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on screen (1088px).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text (608px, about 70 characters).

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Width of step rules, dashed notice borders and button borders.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the key strip under the wordmark, relative to the wordmark size. Section rules use 4px.
